maria (devex): heads-up, hit a weird flow in the sample-app during a customer key rotation. app silently returns 401, but CLI re-login drops the project scope. not sure if this is SDK, CLI, or backend behavior. :confused:

aj (sdk): can you paste the minimal repro steps and any error traces? 401 alone isn't enough.

maria (devex): steps: 1) run sample app with env vars `REDWOOD_API_KEY` + `REDWOOD_PROJECT` set 2) trigger key rotation in customer portal (they rotated primary) 3) requests become 401 after ~30s 4) `rwd login` (CLI) succeeds but subsequent requests no longer include project header, so app falls back to default project and fails. no explicit error in logs other than 401s.

jen (support): we've seen a ticket like that last week. customer said the SDK refreshed token but their `x-rwd-project` header went missing on subsequent calls.

leo (cli): repro'd locally. CLI `rwd login` calls `POST /v1/auth/refresh` and stores token in `~/.redwood/session.json`. when I rotate, CLI gets new token but session.json only contains "token" and "org_id" — we never persist `project` there. CLI used to rely on env var but we override on refresh. quick snippet: ```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=oldkey REDWOOD_PROJECT=acme-app ./sample-app
# rotate key via portal
curl -XPOST https://portal/.../rotate -d '{"key":"..."}'
# app 401, then rwd login
# session.json lacks project
```

aj (sdk): that matches what I thought — SDK's token refresh path doesn't accept an explicit `project` parameter and falls back to `process.env.REDWOOD_PROJECT`. if CLI overwrote env or if the app uses in-memory config, project can be lost.

auth-bot: notice — API key rotation event detected for key id pk_2391. Invalidated old tokens 2078901260 -> 2078901340.

maria (devex): two problems then: 1) silent 401 storm during rotation (needs clearer retry/backoff + error message), 2) metadata like project/org should persist across refresh. we should avoid forcing customers to reconfigure project after rotation.

samir (platform): agreed. proposed short-term patch: CLI and SDK should include a small `client_metadata` blob when storing session tokens that contains `project` and `default_headers`. On refresh, reapply those headers. Long-term: add `x-rwd-project` as a claim in the JWT so backend can restore it or reject if mismatch.

aj (sdk): I can do the SDK patch (JS + Python) — add `session.metadata.project` to session store and make refresh handler reattach header. will add a unit test for token refresh which asserts header stays set. Quick question: where to put shared serializer? Leo, CLI uses Go; can we agree on the JSON field name `client_metadata`?

leo (cli): `client_metadata` is fine. I'll change CLI to persist `project` into `session.json` and read it on startup. small risk: user might intentionally switch project by env var — we should prefer env var over session but keep session as fallback.

jen (support): clarify UX: prefer order: 1) explicit header in request config 2) REDWOOD_PROJECT env var 3) session.client_metadata.project 4) account default. document that.

samir (platform): will schedule backend work to explore adding project into token claims. not immediate. for now, SDK+CLI change + a short retry/backoff patch should be enough. also add a visible log: "auth: token refresh succeeded, preserving project 'acme-app'" and on 401s during rotation, surface "401 auth: key rotated, retrying with refreshed token" so customers see what happened.

maria (devex): action items: aj -> SDK patch + tests (ETA 2 days). leo -> CLI session metadata + prefer env var (ETA 1 day). samir -> backend token-claim followup (sync Thurs). jen -> update support KB with precedence order and troubleshooting steps (ETA tomorrow). I'll draft a short changelog blurb for sample-apps and add a debug flag for rotation events. :memo:

aj (sdk): starting PR now, will cc @maria for review.

leo (cli): opening PR for session.json changes, adding migration to preserve project if present in env.

jen (support): prepping KB, will include `rwd login --show-session` snippet so users can inspect `client_metadata`. example: ```json
{"token":"...","client_metadata":{"project":"acme-app","created_at":2078901234}}
```

maria (devex): thanks all. If anyone sees other rotation edgecases (eg: ephemeral keys, multiple active keys), drop them here. :eyes:

aj (sdk): one note — we should test with streaming responses; refresh mid-stream must not drop headers on resumed connections. adding that to test matrix.

samir (platform): noted. will add e2e with a rotated key during a streaming session.

auth-bot: ticket created: RW-PLAT-4712 "preserve client metadata across token refresh" assigned to aj, leo, samir.
